text:
Samir: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — promised a few clarifications on org moves and hiring. I'll keep this short and answer Qs.
Priya: Thanks. First, is the hiring plan frozen or just deprioritizing non-core roles?
Samir: Not a freeze. We're pausing non-critical IC requisitions for 3 months to focus spend on infra, SRE, and model-serving roles. Strategic hires continue.
Javi: To be concrete: Eng will get 12 new slots for Q2, mostly infra/runtime and a few senior SWE ICs. Manager hiring is limited unless backfilled from a promoted IC.
Leah: Can product still open roles for growth/sales engineering? We have a roadmap dependency.
Priya: Product-facing roles are allowed if tied to revenue/SLA owners. Submit a short case (<3 bullets) to people-ops and cc your manager.
Ian: For teams that lose headcount due to the map change, what's the redeployment process?
Priya: We'll run a 2-week redeploy window. Managers will propose fits; people can express preferences. We'll prioritize internal mobility before external hires.
Mina: On interviewing — we might tighten quality bar for panel slots. Recruiting will focus on senior T-shaped folks to cover more scope.
Leah: Any change to the hiring approval flow? More approvals needed?
Samir: Slight tweak — critical roles still get fast-path approval; others require a short sync with Priya+Javi. Expect ~48h review in normal cases.
Javi: Also, reminder: we will publish an updated team map this week — names, owners, and tentative headcount per pod. That should help managers plan.
Ian: What about compensation budgets for promotions during this period?
Priya: Promotions still go through; comp budget reduced modestly (mid-single-digit %). We will prioritize leveling & retention cases.
Leah: Can managers request exceptions if a role is blocking a customer SLA?
Samir: Yes — file a brief exception request with product+eng leads and CC me. We'll triage and fast-track as needed.
Mina: Recruiters — please pause new reqs not marked "strategic". I'll DM teams with open reqs to triage next steps.
AllhandsBot: Recording: All-hands follow-up saved under team-docs/all-hands/2026-03-23-notes.pdf :page_facing_up:
Priya: Thanks everyone. If anything urgent, drop it here or ping me + Samir. I'll consolidate exception asks tomorrow.
Samir: Appreciate the quick questions — short thread so folks can reference decisions. :thumbsup:
